exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.about: Box breathing is a technique that enables you to take charge of your automatic breathing patterns and train your breath for optimum health.

exercises.name: Plank to Push Up
exercises.about: Plank to push up is a  full-body exercises that target almost the same muscles, help to build core strength, correct posture and improve the range of motion.
steps: Lie straight on your stomach keeping your hands parallel to your shoulders.
Go into a plank position by straightening your arms and lift your ing knee off the floor.
Tighten your stomach and squeeze in your buttocks. Lower your back by bending your elbow, one at a time. Repeat this with alternating arms.
Repeat this exercise for 10-15 repetitions.
Come back again to the original plank position.
dos: Keep your back and body straight.
Keep your arms straight while you’re in a plank position.

exercises.name: Spot Jump
exercises.about: Spot Jump stimulates metabolism and increases oxygen capacity. It improves cardiovascular endurance and also improves circulation of the lymph through the lymph glands.
steps: Stand straight keeping your hands on the waist.
Keep back and spine straight, do not bend forwards.
Start jumping up and down and keep your legs together with knee straight.
Start jumping slowly and then gradually increase the speed.
dos: While jumping keep your feet together.
donts: Perform repetitions as per your endurance and capacity.

exercises.name: Lateral Coastal Breathing
exercises.about: Lateral breathing Promotes mobility of the ribcage. By getting the ribcage to use its full movement potential, we can breathe better, move better through the spine, and allow the shoulder blades to function correctly.

exercises.name: Side Leg Raise
exercises.about: Side leg raise exercise improves the range of motion at the hip joint. It helps in improving body alignment and stabilization.
steps: Lie down on your one side keeping your legs straight.
Your lower arm should rest under your head and your top arm should be on your waist.
Now raise your top leg up straight, keeping your knees straight, and hips steady.
Also keep the shoulder and hip at the same angle.
Lower your leg and repeat with the other side.
dos: Always keep your back in a straight line with your legs.
donts: Do not rotate your hips forward or backward while raising your leg.
Do not bend your knee while raising your leg & do not over stretch your leg.

exercises.name: Front Leg Raise
exercises.about: Front leg raise has a stretching effect on the hamstring muscle.
steps: Lie down straight on your back with your toes pointing upwards.
Bend your right knee and keep your left knee straight on the floor.
Place your hands on the sides.
Contracting your stomach and squeezing your buttocks lift your left leg straight up without lifting your hips.
Slowly lower your left leg and repeat the same with the right leg.
dos: Keep your back straight and flat on the floor.
donts: Do not lift your hips while lifting your leg.

exercises.name: Arm Circle - NAFLD
exercises.about: This warm-up exercise gets your blood moving and can help to build muscle tone in your shoulders, triceps, and biceps. Arm circles can really work on toning the muscles in your shoulder and arm, they also work on upper back muscles.
steps: Stand straight with feet at shoulder width distance.
Keep your back erect, raise and straighten your arms to the side without bending the elbows.
Maintain smooth and deep breathing patterns.
Rotate your arms in a small circular pattern, later making larger circles so as to feel stretch in the arms.
Follow the slow and gradual motion
First do the motion in a clockwise direction followed by anti-clockwise movements.
dos: Keep your head up and your body in a T formation during the entire exercise.
Maintain smooth and deep breathing patterns.
donts: Do not move your arms too fast. Follow the slow and gradual motion

exercises.name: Mid Back rotational stretch
exercises.about: The spine-rotation stretch promotes spinal mobility. A decent stretch can reduce muscle tightness and relieve muscle soreness. Optimizing thoracic rotation can help to open up the chest, improve breathing, and reduce tightness and pain in surrounding joints.

exercises.name: Scapular Retraction
exercises.about: Scapular retractions is highly effective as warm-ups that can help you focus before you begin more rigorous exercises. They also help to strengthen your middle and upper back muscles.

exercises.name: Bridging Exercise
exercises.about: A bridge exercise isolates and strengthens your gluteus (butt) muscles — the gluteus maximus, medius and minimus — and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Side Lunge
exercises.about: Side lunges exercise helps to develop your balance, stability and lower body strength. It works on your inner and outer thighs thereby strengthening inner and outer thigh muscles.
steps: Stand straight with legs wide open and toes pointing forward.
Keep your hand together near your chest.
Shift your body weight to one leg bending the knee until it reaches a 90-degree angle, and the other leg is straight, with your toes pointing forward and your hips back.
Return to the centre by keeping the leg straight and switching the sides.
dos: Always keep your back, shoulders, chin straight.
donts: Do not bend your knee too much that it touches the floor. Always keep it in the air.
Do not bend the opposite leg knee. Maintain it straight.
Do not move your back forward or backwards.
